# User Story: Account Management REST API

**As a** user of the Account Management service,

**I want** to be able to create, retrieve, update, delete, and list account information through a REST API,

**So that** account data can be managed efficiently and accessed by other applications and services.

## Acceptance Criteria

* [ ] The API allows a user to create an account.
* [ ] The API allows a user to retrieve an account by its ID.
* [ ] The API allows a user to update an existing account.
* [ ] The API allows a user to delete an account.
* [ ] The API allows a user to retrieve a list of accounts.
* [ ] The API returns appropriate HTTP status codes for successful and unsuccessful requests.
* [ ] Invalid account requests are handled appropriately.
* [ ] Automated tests are created for the REST API functionality.
* [ ] The application maintains at least 95% code coverage.
* [ ] All tests pass before the feature is considered complete.

## Definition of Done

* [ ] REST API endpoints are implemented.
* [ ] Unit and route tests have been written using Test Driven Development.
* [ ] All tests pass.
* [ ] Code coverage is at least 95%.
* [ ] Code follows the project's existing structure and coding standards.
* [ ] Changes are committed and pushed to GitHub.
* [ ] The feature is ready for integration into the DevOps pipeline.
